**Course Description:**
This course equips frontline staff and volunteers with the core skills needed for client-facing roles in community services. Topics include active listening, de-escalation, referral pathways, documentation basics, and self-care.

**Target Participants:** New hires, interns, and volunteers in client-facing roles.

**Learning Outcomes:**
By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
1. Apply active listening techniques in a simulated intake conversation.
2. Identify signs of distress and apply a de-escalation framework.
3. Locate and use the organisation's referral directory.
4. Complete a standard case note with required fields.
5. Recognise personal triggers and apply a basic self-care plan.

**Course Structure:**
- Component 1: Classroom sessions (theory + role-play)
- Component 2: Guided practice with a mentor
- Component 3: Written assessment
- Component 4: Practical observation

**Assessment:**
- Written test: 20 multiple-choice questions
- Practical observation: 1 simulated client interaction
- Passing score: 80% for both components

**Trainer Requirements:**
- Minimum 2 years of frontline service experience
- Completed Train-the-Trainer (TtT) programme
- Valid certification on file with the Training Unit

documents.content:
**Course Description:**
This course equips frontline staff and volunteers with the core skills needed for client-facing roles in community services. Topics include active listening, de-escalation, referral pathways, documentation basics, and self-care.

**Target Participants:** New hires, interns, and volunteers in client-facing roles.

**Learning Outcomes:**
By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
1. Apply active listening techniques in a simulated intake conversation.
2. Identify signs of distress and apply a de-escalation framework.
3. Locate and use the organisation's referral directory.
4. Complete a standard case note with required fields.
5. Recognise personal triggers and apply a basic self-care plan.

**Course Structure:**
- Component 1: Classroom sessions (theory + role-play)
- Component 2: Guided practice with a mentor
- Component 3: Written assessment
- Component 4: Practical observation

**Assessment:**
- Written test: 20 multiple-choice questions
- Practical observation: 1 simulated client interaction
- Passing score: 80% for both components

**Trainer Requirements:**
- Minimum 2 years of frontline service experience
- Completed Train-the-Trainer (TtT) programme
- Valid certification on file with the Training Unit

**Version History:**
- v1.0 (2022) — Initial release
- v2.0 (2023) — Updated referral directory section
- v3.1 (2024) — Added self-care module
- v4.2 (2025) — Clarified assessment instructions; updated case note template
